gloss: ups and downs of life; rise and fall

definitions.gloss: the rise and fall; the vicissitudes of life
definitions.explanation: The natural cycle of prosperity and decline that affects all people, organizations, and nations throughout history.

examples.japanese: {栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい}は{世|よ}の{常|つね}だ。
examples.english: Rise and fall are the way of the world.

examples.japanese: この{城|しろ}は{栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい}の{歴史|れきし}を{見|み}てきた。
examples.english: This castle has witnessed the rise and fall of history.

examples.japanese: {企業|きぎょう}の{栄枯盛衰|えいこせいすい}は{避|さ}けられない。
examples.english: The rise and fall of companies is inevitable.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}): This is a four-character compound idiom.

CHARACTER BREAKDOWN:
・{栄|えい} - prosperity, flourishing
・{枯|こ} - withering, decline
・{盛|せい} - thriving, peak
・{衰|すい} - decline, wane

STRUCTURE: The four characters form two contrasting pairs:
- {栄|えい}/{枯|こ} (flourishing vs. withering)
- {盛|せい}/{衰|すい} (thriving vs. declining)

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Historical narratives about dynasties or civilizations
- Business discussions about industry cycles
- Philosophical reflections on life's impermanence
- Buddhist concept of {諸行無常|しょぎょうむじょう} (impermanence)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{盛者必衰|じょうしゃひっすい} (the mighty must fall - from {平家物語|へいけものがたり})
・{浮沈|ふちん} (rise and fall)
・{興亡|こうぼう} (rise and fall of nations)
